text: A1: Android scaffold — Compose/Hilt/Room/Retrofit, theme, nav

./gradlew assembleDebug lint test is green: 9/9 unit tests pass, 0 lint
errors, debug APK builds. Verified on a real bootstrapped Java 17 /
Gradle 8.14.5 / Android SDK (platform 36, build-tools 36.0.0) toolchain,
not just typechecked.

AGP: stayed on 8.13.2 (not 9.x) — Hilt's Gradle plugin and KSP don't
support AGP 9's built-in Kotlin yet, and AGP 9's floor drags in
compileSdk 37 across core-ktx/lifecycle/hilt-navigation-compose. Hilt
pinned to 2.57.2 (last version compatible with AGP 8.x).

Environment note: this sandbox is ARM64 Linux; Google ships no
linux_aarch64 AAPT2 build (checked through the latest 9.4 alpha), so
AAPT2 runs under qemu-user-x86_64 with a minimal glibc sysroot, wired
in via AGP's aapt2FromMavenOverride. That's set only in this machine's
~/.gradle/gradle.properties, not in the repo, so the project stays
portable to normal x86_64 environments.

Not verified: actual app launch / dark-light theme screenshot from the
acceptance criteria — no Android emulator available in this sandbox
(would need hardware-accelerated virtualization). Everything else in
the acceptance criteria is met.
